purpose: Diagnose two rejected pre52 Render cutover attempts and correct deployment/startup behavior without altering the qualified pre52 public feature layer.

observedEvidence.bothAttempts: Render deploy hook returned a deploy id but /api/release-identity for pre52 never became active before the approximately seven-minute workflow gate expired.
observedEvidence.rollbackEvidence: Health remained OK and the captured professional-growth page contained SMARTER_JUSTICE_PRE49_SOURCE_CURRENTNESS_GATE. The workflow incorrectly checked SMARTER_JUSTICE_PRE49_RULE_SOURCE_CURRENTNESS, causing false rollback-verification failure.

officialRenderEvidence.finding: A new web-service deploy must pass health checks before receiving traffic; Render can wait up to 15 minutes before canceling a new deploy that does not become healthy.
A web service must bind to a port reachable on 0.0.0.0 and should use the PORT environment variable.
A deploy hook can deploy a specific commit with the ref query parameter and returns a deploy id when a deploy starts.
The old instance continues serving until the new instance builds, starts, passes health checks, and is promoted.

decisions.item: Keep exhaustive inherited/overlay qualification in build/CI, not in the production start command before port binding.
Add a fast fail-closed startup guard that verifies exact pre53 runtime identity, runtime version and PORT compatibility, then starts the server immediately.
Separate exact release cutover waiting from the heavier public/AI acceptance suite.
Wait beyond Render's documented 15-minute promotion ceiling before declaring cutover failure.
Verify rollback with the actual accepted pre49 marker.
All pre52 public, attorney, mobile, working-only and data-continuity behavior remains intact.
